rationale: A visitor expects Markdown links between docs pages to preserve the application document, like sidebar links.

check: X002 relative Markdown file links reach the intended page
rationale: A docs author expects ./page.md and ../section/page.md links to reach published pages.

check: X003 impossible no-match query returns zero results
rationale: A search query absent from the corpus should not return unrelated fallback hits.

check: X004 documented default fuzzy search finds a single missing-letter typo
rationale: Default fuzzy: 0.2 should find Installation for Installaton.

check: X005 fixed unambiguous queries rank the expected page first
rationale: A visitor expects a unique title, heading or body term to rank its owning page first.

check: X006 search snippets keep word boundaries between Markdown blocks
rationale: A visitor expects plain-text search snippets to retain spaces between list items, table cells, and other Markdown blocks, rather than joining words. The composable excerpt is rendered without application transformations.

check: X101 negation cannot escape requested locale
rationale: An exact-locale query with $not: { locale } must return no rows, never other locales (E-A009).

check: X102 singleton localized sitemap keeps hreflang and x-default
rationale: A single available variant still has a real language and a default URL (E-X1).

check: X103 Japanese search finds Japanese content
rationale: Readers must be able to search Japanese content using Japanese words.

check: X201 blog guide source glob yields the documented mount-relative slug
rationale: The Build a blog guide promises route /blog/<slug> for files under a source folder with mount /blog.

check: X202 dotted projection returns selected nested authored value
rationale: Projection should retain a named nested field without disclosing sibling fields. The installed public API uses select; only/without are not documented public options.

check: X203 query results do not mutate the sealed provider cache
rationale: A returned document is a snapshot; editing it should not corrupt later provider reads.

check: X204 aggregate ETag represents both query dependencies
rationale: A response derived from two content dependencies must not represent only the last dependency in its validator.

check: X205 K202 malformed JSON is rejected by isolated production-built filesystem parser
rationale: A malformed JSON source must cause a parser error; returning an empty document silently loses content. Tested in an isolated local production build to prevent breaking every blog query.

check: X401 all 20 unique tokens are searchable in each locale
rationale: Default MiniSearch must find exact owning pages across the entire corpus, including pages 101 and 1000; preserve E-A003 failures.
